name: Rudra Dave
headline: AI & Automation Developer: Generative AI, AI agents, Python, TypeScript

bullets: Worked on dashboard development, local LLM integration, OpenClaw-based multi-agent orchestration, and MCP server integration (includes NDA-protected initiatives).
Built custom skills and workflows to extend Claude Code and other AI coding tools, cutting AI token usage by roughly 70% without a drop in output quality.

Built an end-to-end knowledge-transfer automation workflow in n8n, integrated with Google Chat Workspace. It auto-creates a transition group, assigns KT tasks, tracks completion, and sends reminders. Reduced personnel transition time 85 to 91% with zero data loss during handovers.
Used the Google ecosystem (GCP, GA4, DV360) to build data-driven tracking systems.

Ran event management for the largest student committee at PDEU (22 clubs), leading a team of 150+ across flagship events including Gandhinagar's largest hackathon (36 hours, 200+ participants) and Tesseract, a flagship event with international participation.
Managed sponsorship and stakeholder tie-ups with government organizations; trained and mentored the student teams running execution.

summary: B.Tech Computer Engineering student at PDEU (2027) building Generative AI and AI-agent solutions for business workflows. Two internships at Tatvic Analytics (Google Premier Partner) delivering multi-agent orchestration, MCP integrations and n8n automation that cut handover time by up to 91%. Comfortable across Python, TypeScript, REST APIs, prompt engineering and cloud, and working in Agile teams.
